title: add RAG agent tool-calling examples and docs quickstarts
author: Sofia Martinez
description: Add a set of RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent quickstarts and tool-calling examples plus updates to the docs site navigation and a handful of small test harnesses. Motivation: customers keep asking for end-to-end examples that show how to wire up a retriever, a RAG prompt template, and tool calls (search, knowledge-base lookup, and a simple action executor). This PR ships three runnable examples (python, typescript, and a minimal dockerized agent), a new docs quickstart page with step-by-step instructions and config snippets, and updates the docs site nav to surface the examples under 'Quickstarts -> Agents'. The changes are intentionally example-focused: no runtime changes, all code is opt-in in the redwood-examples directory. The PR includes a short test harness to validate tool-calling loop behavior and CI plays the examples smoke test in the docs pipeline.
